objectives:
(1) Participate in school activities to understand personal body composition and physical movement capabilities.
(2) Upgrade athletic skills to improve movement efficiency and self-defense capabilities.
(3) Advance sports and health knowledge to cultivate the ability for self-fitness and physical conditioning.
content:
Week 1 - Sep. 11 Overview of school physical education and introduction to sports facilities.
Week 2 - Sep. 18 Basic warm up and physical activity, Softball practice
Week 3 - Sep. 25 Holiday
Week 4 - Oct. 2 Fitness Test practice (including abdominal crunches, Standing Long Jump, Sit-and-Reach Test, YO-YO test), Softball practice
Week 5 - Oct. 9 Holiday
Week 6- Oct. 16 Fitness Test
Week 7- Oct. 23 Softball practice
Week 8 - Oct. 30 Mid exam (Softball throw)
Week 9 - Nov. 6 Sports day event practice (Fun games)
Week 10- Nov. 13 Attend the school Sports Day event (11/11)
Week 11- Nov. 20 Running endurance training I, jump rope.
Week 12- Nov. 27 Running endurance training II, jump rope.
Week 13 - Dec. 4 Attend the NCU Marathon (12/1)
Week 14 - Dec. 11 jump rope
Week 15 - Dec. 18 Final exam (jump rope)
Week 16 - Dec. 25 Holiday
books: NCU PE Office / Course Related Materials
teaching_method:
講授

實習/實驗
個別指導
grading_policy: Attendance & Participation 40%, Attitude 10%, Softball Throw 15%, Jump Rope 15%, NCU Games & Marathon 20%
